external_bodies: Host files/services outside the seven declared raw roots
relocated_paths: Profile 19/20 commands retain old absolute paths; RELOCATION.json binds the move. Dangling original current aliases are metadata.
scope: All present regular bytes and cases in the declared roots retained. This does not reconstruct absent ephemeral data or revalidate external bodies.
symlinks: Literal targets are retained for symlinks without following or rewriting them; original modes are retained for regular files and directories only.
